description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing SHA1-HMAC cryptographic functions, including context management, key setting, transformation, and finalization, specifically for Infineon Technologies hardware.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_transform
methods.description: Saves input block to context, handles workaround for DBN size.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey
methods.description: Sets SHA1 HMAC key, supports keys longer than 64 bytes by hashing.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_setkey_hw
methods.description: Loads SHA1 HMAC key into hardware registers.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 HMAC context before processing.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_update
methods.description: Processes input data for SHA1 HMAC.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_final_impl
methods.description: Performs final or intermediate SHA1 HMAC processing, interacts with hardware hash engine.

methods.name: sha1_hmac_exit_tfm
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for transformation context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_sha1_hmac
methods.description: Registers SHA1 HMAC driver with kernel crypto API.
